verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is a data-center AI accelerator sold in DGX/HGX systems for LLM training and inference, so high-refresh 4K consumer gaming is outside its product category. The evidence pack contains no gaming features, display-output claims or game benchmarks that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
